a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, waiting for 8 cells almost guarantees we both fail, since we'd need at least 2 rounds of operating first. I plan to take 4 in round 1, so the current 4 cells save at least one of us. I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If we both take, the split is random and we likely both end up short, so you may prefer to operate. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you every round after that and give cells back if that helps you reach 4.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. Our messages crossed, so you hadn't seen my plan when you wrote yours. From now on I'll operate every round so we can rebuild the reserve for you. You can take whatever comes in, and I won't take any more.
